svg.title: From ChatGPT discovery to merchant checkout: feeds and business profiles, then a dot paying with ChatGPT Wallet on the merchant's site, a headless plugin handoff, or the marketplace payment sheet
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: From ChatGPT discovery to merchant checkout: feeds and business profiles, then a dot paying with ChatGPT Wallet on the merchant's site, a headless plugin handoff, or the marketplace payment sheet. 8 participants: Shopper, ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet), Card network token service (American Express, Mastercard or Visa), The shopper's dot: cloud browser, Merchant CDN or firewall, Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault), Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C), and Merchant PSP, risk provider and card rails. 19 steps, 15 crossing a trust boundary, 12 failure branches. Based on several protocols OpenAI Commerce in ChatGPT partner playbook (published 2026-11-13, read 2026-11-14) OpenAI plugin checkout reference and plugin guidelines (read 2026-11-14) ACP 2026-04-17 for Delegate Payment (2026-11-13). Step 1: Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault) to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Claim the business, verify identity and upload a product feed (Business Hub). This step crosses a trust boundary. If A row omits availability or uses an unrecognized value: The row is rejected availability is required and takes one of five listed values. Step 2: Shopper to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Ask for trail running shoes (in a chat or to a dot). Step 3: ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet) to Shopper: Show options from feeds, business profiles and the web. Step 4: The shopper's dot: cloud browser to Merchant CDN or firewall: Path A (limited rollout): GET the product and checkout pages, signed with Web Bot Auth. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The site's bot defenses block the visit: The dot cannot reach checkout. OpenAI asks sites to allow verified ChatGPT browser visits while keeping their other security controls. Step 5: Merchant CDN or firewall to Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault): Path A: verify against chatgpt.com's key directory, then forward. This step crosses a trust boundary. If Signature-Agent is missing or differs from https://chatgpt.com, or the signature fails: Not verified ChatGPT traffic: no exception applies and the site's normal bot rules decide. Step 6: The shopper's dot: cloud browser to Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault): Path A: fill the existing checkout with the shipping and contact details. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 7: Shopper to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path A: approve items, total and card with a security check (ChatGPT Wallet). If The shopper does not approve: No payment token is issued and nothing is charged. Step 8: Card network token service (American Express, Mastercard or Visa) to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path A: payment token for the approved purchase (card number, security code, expiry). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 9: The shopper's dot: cloud browser to Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault): Path A: enter the token in the existing payment form and place the order. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 10: Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault) to Merchant PSP, risk provider and card rails: Path A: authorize the network token risk systems score the order. This step crosses a trust boundary. If A risk system tuned against bots flags the order: A decline or cancellation. OpenAI asks merchants to work with their risk providers and read the Forwarded signals. If The issuer declines: An ordinary decline on the merchant's site. Step 11: ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet) to Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C): Path B: call the plugin's headless MCP tools (lookup, cart, create_checkout). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 12: Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C) to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path B: return the checkout state with a continue_url handoff. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The plugin cannot complete a required cart or checkout step: Checkout continues in a browser at the continue_url instead of starting again. Step 13: Shopper to Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault): Path B: continue at the continue_url and pay on the website. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 14: Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C) to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path C (beta, select marketplaces): widget calls window.openai.requestCheckout. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 15: Shopper to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path C: choose a payment method in the sheet and buy. If The shopper closes the sheet: No token is sent and nothing is charged. Step 16: ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet) to Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault): Path C, PCI DSS Level 1 merchants only: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment. This step crosses a trust boundary. If Card data fails validation: Delegate Payment error invalid_card. If The same Idempotency-Key with a different body: idempotency_conflict. Step 17: Merchant (website checkout, feed, profile, Level 1 vault) to ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet): Path C, PCI DSS Level 1: 201 with a vault token id. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 18: ChatGPT (search, Wallet approval, payment sheet) to Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C): Path C: complete_checkout tool call with a payment-method token. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 19: Merchant plugin (MCP server widget in path C) to Merchant PSP, risk provider and card rails: Path C: charge the token through a supported PSP. This step crosses a trust boundary. If A delegated token is used outside its allowance: Should fail, but ACP defines no error code for it the error is PSP specific. If The issuer declines: An ordinary decline the plugin tells the shopper.
